details:
Local testing with few additional tricks can be used with multiple profiles, this is very useful for testing many maps due to huge amount of bugs in local testing when using the same client: https://vrchat.canny.io/sdk-bug-reports/p/sdk862-offline-test-option-is-broken-with-multiple-clients
I'm author of GotoUdon tool that make this simpler and works by just starting a new vrchat instance using this command line:
```
--enable-debug-gui --enable-sdk-log-levels --enable-udon-debug-logging --profile=11 "--url=create?roomId=6741556427&hidden=true&name=BuildAndRun_GotoUdon&url=file:///C:/Users/.../AppData/Local/Temp/DefaultCompany/.../customscene2.vrcw" --no-vr
```
Sadly some users have issue when most of the time (but not always) only one client is allowed to join and the other one is stuck inside a loop with this in logs:
```
Log   [RoomManager] Entering Room: Local Test
Log   [RoomManager] Joining local:e571e0f553c75fe78f30b3459c513aa284a0ae4a81b6304265c511e69ba22c25
Log   [RoomManager] Joining or Creating Room: Local Test
Log   [RoomManager] Successfully joined room
Log   [VRCFlowManagerVRC] Spent 0.0001296997s entering world.
Log   [VRCFlowManagerVRC] Waiting for Photon to enter room
Log   [NetworkManager] OnConnected
Log   [NetworkManager] OnJoinRoomFailed
Error [VRCFlowNetworkManager] OnPhotonJoinRoomFailed. error code = 32752 msg = 32752
Log   [VRCFlowManagerVRC] Resetting game flow because "OnPhotonJoinRoomFailed for unknown reasons": [SkipLogin, TryAlternateInstance]
Log   [RoomManager] Clearing Room Metadata
Log   [VRCFlowManagerVRC] ResetGameFlow: choosing alternate instance. destid=local:e571e0f553c75fe78f30b3459c513aa284a0ae4a81b6304265c511e69ba22c25:53286
Log   [VRCFlowManagerVRC] ResetGameFlow: choosing alternate instance. Was local:e571e0f553c75fe78f30b3459c513aa284a0ae4a81b6304265c511e69ba22c25:53286, is now local:e571e0f553c75fe78f30b3459c513aa284a0ae4a81b6304265c511e69ba22c25:52506; ignored 
Log   [VRCFlowManagerVRC] Destination set: local:e571e0f553c75fe78f30b3459c513aa284a0ae4a81b6304265c511e69ba22c25:52506
Log   [RoomManager] Clearing Room Metadata
```
And I can no see anything to prevent that, this seems to be related to particular users and their map. I'm unable to reproduce this using project provided by other person with the issue, yet the issue does not happen on clean project, but does after importing that sample project.
The issue also happens if instead of file URL the URL to the asset to uploaded version of the world will be used. (but again, only to these affected users)
I'm also reporting this via e-mail, there I included more information that I didn't want to include here for privacy/security:
- id of world
- url used for testing
- user ids of main and alt account used for testing
- download of exported scene
- full logs of both clients, the one working and the one in loop
title: Local testing sometimes does not work with different profiles, OnPhotonJoinRoomFailed 32752
